mapper.select: select compo_id from sys_industry_view_compo_rel where industry_view_id = #{industryViewId}

select view.id viewId, rel.view_name viewName, rel.display_type displayType, 0 viewType, view.view_json viewJson, view.base_map_json baseMapJson, view.img_url imgUrl, view.create_time createTime, view.update_time updateTime, view.status, rel.industry_view_type, rel.sort from sys_industry_view view INNER JOIN sys_industry_view_rel as rel on rel.industry_view_id = view.id and rel.industry_view_type = 1 inner join sys_industry_ver_conf as vconf on vconf.industry_code = rel.industry_code and vconf.app_ver_code = rel.app_ver_code inner join sys_industry_conf as conf on vconf.industry_code = conf.industry_code and vconf.accept_node = conf.accept_node where view.delete_flag = '0' and vconf.delete_flag = '0' AND conf.delete_flag='0' AND vconf.industry_code = #{industryCode} AND vconf.app_ver_code = #{appVerCode} and vconf.accept_node = #{acceptNode} order by rel.sort asc, view.id;

select view.id viewId, rel.view_name viewName, rel.display_type displayType, 0 viewType, view.img_url imgUrl, view.screen_url screenUrl, view.create_time createTime, view.update_time updateTime, rel.industry_view_type, view.screen_compo_type screenCompoType, rel.sort from sys_industry_screen view INNER JOIN sys_industry_view_rel as rel on rel.industry_view_id = view.id and rel.industry_view_type = 2 inner join sys_industry_ver_conf as vconf on vconf.industry_code = rel.industry_code and vconf.app_ver_code = rel.app_ver_code inner join sys_industry_conf as conf on vconf.industry_code = conf.industry_code and vconf.accept_node = conf.accept_node where view.delete_flag = '0' and vconf.delete_flag = '0' AND conf.delete_flag='0' AND vconf.industry_code = #{industryCode} AND vconf.app_ver_code = #{appVerCode} and vconf.accept_node = #{acceptNode} order by rel.sort asc, view.id;

select c.id viewId, rel.screen_alias viewName, c.screen_url screenUrl, 1 viewType, rel.display_type displayType, c.sso_flag ssoFlag, c.screen_type from `sys_third_party_screen_tenant_rel` rel inner join `sys_third_party_screen_conf` c on rel.`third_party_screen_id` = c.id where rel.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and rel.industry_code = #{industryCode} and rel.app_ver_code = #{appVerCode} and c.delete_flag = 0
AND c.id in
#{item}
order by c.create_time, c.id
